## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `78cfc281fea6a9825e62bef2fc7e0cfc82cdd564`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md, skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json + scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs, .changeset/33714-home-currency-rollup-skill.md

Read, never reviewed (origin/main `d3bea96d`): `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` (`collectRecordCurrencyPathErrors`, case (d)), `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` (`refuseUnadmittedSummaryCurrency`), `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts` (`CurrencyConfigSchema` jsdoc, `Field.summary`, `summaryOperations`), `content/docs/data-modeling/currency.mdx`, `ui/packages/fields/src/currency.ts` and `widgets/SummaryField.tsx`, ADR-0144 D8 rule 5.

Check-runs on this head (42): 12 success, 16 skipped, 0 failed, 14 still running. Green: Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Build Core, Type Check · source gates, Check PR Size, filter, Plan Test Core shards, Test UI, Live E2E UI, Dogfood Regression Gate, Auto Label. Still running, so no verdict yet: Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus, Lint · scoped · query-options erasure, Type Check · workspace, Type Check · consumer gates, Type Check · debt ledger, Test Core 1/8, 2/8, 3/8 (shards 4 to 8 not yet listed). The skill gates (token ratchet, skill-examples, skill-docs, skill-links) sit in the Lint families that are still running: this record judges the contract, and those conclusions stay CI's.

### ① Derived judgments

Each taught sentence against main:

- "A `sum` / `min` / `max` / `avg` `summary` over a child's `homeAmount.field` declares `currencyMode: 'dynamic'`, no `defaultCurrency`". HOLDS. `stack.zod.ts` case (d): "A `summary` (`sum`, `min`, `max`, `avg`) declaring `currencyMode: 'dynamic'` ... is admitted only when the child field it rolls up is a stored home amount: a field that some `currencyConfig.homeAmount.field` on the child object names (#33659)". `object.zod.ts`: "A `dynamic` summary that names no child amount, or carries a `defaultCurrency` (which `dynamic` never reads, and which would name the home currency in metadata), is refused here."
- "It shows in `localization.currency`". HOLDS. `currency.mdx`: "The Console then draws the total in `localization.currency` on the record page and in the list cell"; `summaryDeclaresCurrency` returns true for `dynamic`, and `SummaryField` then formats with `resolveFieldCurrency(field, tenantCurrency, ...)`.
- "without it, as a bare number". HOLDS on both readings of "it" (see N1): `currency.mdx` "Without the declaration the roll-up stays a bare number"; `currency.ts` "a plain number when none is set".
- "`defineStack` (`os validate`, the build) refuses `'dynamic'` on any other roll-up". HOLDS. Case (d): "Any other `dynamic` roll-up is refused"; `currency.mdx`: "by `defineStack` (`os validate` and the build)". Simplified, acceptably: a child the stack knows only through an extension is judged by the engine registry instead, and the running-server 422 half is left to `currency.mdx`.
- "and any `currencyConfig` on a `count`". HOLDS. `object.zod.ts`: "a `count` roll-up refuses every mode, `fixed` included"; message "A count is a number of rows, never an amount, so it has no currency: delete `currencyConfig`." The object door runs inside the object parse, so naming `defineStack` is true.
- "(ADR-0144: metadata never names the home currency, so never `'fixed'` with it)". HOLDS as an authoring rule: ADR-0144 D8 rule 5, "Metadata never names the home currency." The text rightly does not claim a refusal: `fixed` on a sum/min/max/avg still parses.
- Snippet. `Field.summary` exists (`field.zod.ts`), `relationshipField` is optional and auto-detected, the config names a child object and field with no `defaultCurrency` (passes the object door), and with `expense.amount_home` named by a valid `homeAmount.field` it passes case (d). It is the shape of the sibling `subtotal` snippet in the same section and of the `currency.mdx` example. Parses in the skill's dialect and passes the refinement.

### ② Semver level

`'@objectstack/skills': patch`: the right package (`packages/skills/package.json`) and the level every other pending skills changeset on main uses; prose only, no schema or runtime. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are present on both the PR body and the changeset, and both are true of the tree: nothing narrows, no protocol surface moves. Check Changeset is green.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Authoring route. The claim and the dev report say the `skills/**` text was written by an isolated os-dev subagent pinned to the contract tier because the thread is served below it. The tree cannot show this: the one commit carries the thread's session trailer (`session_01ADHkmPwzDmc8SYayZfateR`). Recorded as declared, not verified; the text itself was judged on its merits in ① and ④.
- Paid-down cut 1, the `currency` row's key list to "(§ Currency)". Home kept and reachable: the `### Currency` snippet and prose in the same file spell `currencyMode`, `defaultCurrency`, `currencyField` and `homeAmount`. 45 bytes, as stated.
- Paid-down cut 2, the Autonumber snippet. Home kept: the `autonumber` row (`format` (shorthand) / `autonumberFormat` (canonical), e.g. `"CASE-{0000}"`) and the token table's `CASE-{0000}` row. 70 bytes, as stated. No fact lost.
- Ratchet raise. Measured: 12821 B to 13397 B, net +576 (+691 new, 115 cut); ceil(13397 / 4) = 3350, pinned at the measurement, zero headroom. The file grows 144 tokens (3206 to 3350); the ceiling moves 142 because 2 tokens of slack were absorbed. The new text costs about 173 tokens gross, about 29 paid down. Proportionate to a six-line paragraph and a three-line snippet; the comment's arithmetic is right. The two record ids it cites were not in this review's inputs; the first is cited by 37 other rows on main.
- Eval case at the tail. Ids 1 to 20 are unique; no existing case is touched; the `writeRequiresMasterRead` case #33432 holds is id 17, untouched. Residual risk: if #33432 also appends at the tail, the two meet textually at the closing lines and on id 20; whoever lands second rebases.
- Behind main. 7 commits behind (`fb79d47c` to `d3bea96d`). `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main` is clean (tree `69f637b0`). Main touched other rows of the ratchet script only and nothing under `skills/objectstack-data/`, so the 13397 B pin survives the merge.
- Landing tier (`check-governed-merges --pr 34076`, read-only): GOVERNED, landing tier H (人合). `skills/**` ×2 hit the register. The low-risk skills arm does not apply, because `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` is a path outside skills wording. The PR is a draft, correctly.
- Local runs: nothing built or run from the diff. Two read-only PM scripts were run as ordered (`record-recognisers --template`, `check-governed-merges --pr`).

### ④ Design judgment

`field-types.md`: true against the spec on main and the card's fix shape (admitted shape, home-field-only, `count` never carries a currency), and placed directly after the `homeAmount` paragraph it depends on, before the parent-currency line, mirroring that paragraph's own "summary snippet" form. It agrees with the "Currency resolution" paragraph above it (`'dynamic'`: tenant `localization.currency`, else a plain number) and with `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md` ("measure its `homeAmount` field or the parent's `summary`"). No statement under `skills/**` contradicts it.

Eval case 20: self-consistent as written (every `must_contain` is in `expected_output`, no `must_not_contain` is). It tests the card's scenario and the tempting wrong answer.

- F1 (should-fix). `must_not_contain: "defaultCurrency"` fails a correct answer. The rule this PR teaches reads "declares `currencyMode: 'dynamic'`, no `defaultCurrency`", and the card says the same; an answer that restates it, or that answers the prompt's question with "do not set `defaultCurrency: 'USD'`", is scored wrong. The expected output passes only by paraphrasing ("with no currency code"). Use the code spelling the file's other cases use (`assignee:`, `label: '负责人'`), for example `defaultCurrency:`, or drop the entry. `currencyMode: 'fixed'` has the same weakness for an answer that says "not `currencyMode: 'fixed'`", but a restatement of the rule ("never `'fixed'`") avoids it and case 18 sets the precedent, so that half is a nit.
- N1 (nit). "It shows in `localization.currency`; without it, as a bare number." The nearest antecedent of "it" is `localization.currency`, not the declaration. Both readings are true, so nothing false is taught; "undeclared, a bare number" would be exact.
- N2 (nit). "(§ Currency)" is the only "§" pointer in this file; its other pointers use the arrow form ("objectstack-ui → Dashboards").
- N3 (nit). The snippet omits `relationshipField`, which `currency.mdx` writes. Correct while `expense` has one relation to `project`, and the `summary` row already lists the key as optional.

No must-fix. One should-fix (F1), three nits.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-iroo1f`
Reviewed-by: `session_01ADHkmRxXmVQ41fqnaTPGAv`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`

Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md, skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json + scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs, .changeset/33714-home-currency-rollup-skill.md

Delta record. It reopens record 6898808993 (head `78cfc281`) only for what moved: a merge of origin/main (`a640ecf3`) and one fix commit (`7c9814a6`). Everything else in that record stands.

Check-runs on this head (27 listed, 0 failed). Final: Governed Surface Queue Guard success, Type Check · workspace success, Check PR Size success, Auto Label success, PR-body guards success on the first run. Skipped, final: 7 (queue verdicts, schedule gate, the two opt-in harnesses, and the duplicate Check PR Size and Auto Label). Still running, so no verdict yet (15): Check Changeset (both runs), PR-body guards (second run), filter, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus, Lint · scoped · query-options erasure, Type Check · source gates, Type Check · consumer gates, Type Check · debt ledger. Build Core and the Test Core shards are not listed yet. The dev did not re-run the derived command set on this head, so the token ratchet and the skill gates have no verdict on it until the Lint families finish: those conclusions are CI's and are not given here.

### ① Derived judgments

Unchanged from 6898808993, with one sentence re-tested: "It shows in `localization.currency`; undeclared, a bare number." HOLDS, now on one reading only: `currency.mdx` "Without the declaration the roll-up stays a bare number." The snippet is untouched.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. The changeset file did not move in this round.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Merge. The head contains origin/main `d3bea96d` and is 0 commits behind; `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main` is clean (tree `b6f7aea6`). The net diff against main is the same four files, +53 / -9. The `filters.md` ratchet row visible between the two heads is main's own, brought in by the merge.
- Ratchet re-pin. Measured: `field-types.md` is 13395 B; ceil(13395 / 4) = 3349. Net +574 over 12821 = +689 new, 115 cut; ceiling +141; zero headroom. The two bytes saved are the fix commit's (the pointer glyph +1, the rewording -3). The comment's arithmetic is right.
- The cut homes, the tail eval case, the authoring-route note and the landing tier (H, governed, draft) stand as recorded.

### ④ Design judgment

- F1: closed. `must_not_contain` is now only `defaultCurrency: 'USD'`. Read against the prompt: it asks "can I just set the total's currency to USD?" and never spells `defaultCurrency`. An answer that restates the taught rule ("`currencyMode: 'dynamic'`, no `defaultCurrency`", "never `'fixed'` with it") passes; an answer that authors the wrong config (`{ currencyMode: 'fixed', defaultCurrency: 'USD' }`) is caught, so dropping the `currencyMode: 'fixed'` entry loses no coverage. The expected output still satisfies its own assertions.
- N4 (nit, new, residual of F1). A correct answer that quotes the wrong code in order to refuse it ("do not add `defaultCurrency: 'USD'`") still trips the entry. That is the file's standing convention for a negative pattern (case 18 `currencyMode: 'fixed'`, case 19 `label: '负责人'`), the prompt does not hand the answer that spelling, and a string check cannot tell quoting from authoring. Not a correctness matter for the taught rule.
- N1: closed. "undeclared, a bare number" has one reading, and it is the true one.
- N2: closed. `(→ Currency)` is the arrow form the file's other pointers use; the heading it names is in the same file.
- N3: open, nit, skipped by the dev. The snippet still omits `relationshipField`; correct while `expense` has one relation to `project`. No effect on the verdict.

No must-fix, no should-fix. Two nits open (N3, N4).

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-iroo1f`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`objectstack-data` 的 `field-types.md` 在「货币」一节补一段和一个三行示例:对子对象本位币字段(`homeAmount.field` 指的那个)做 `sum/min/max/avg` 的汇总字段,声明 `currencyConfig: { currencyMode: 'dynamic' }`、不写 `defaultCurrency`,显示时用组织本位币;其他汇总写 `dynamic` 会被 `defineStack` 拒,`count` 不能带任何 `currencyConfig`;按 ADR-0144 不能用 `fixed` 写死本位币。评测加第 20 例。为腾篇幅删了同文件两处重复(货币行的键清单、自动编号示例,规则都还在本文件别处)。+53/−9,changeset `@objectstack/skills: patch`。
- 为什么改:#33710 放开了这种汇总写法,技能没教,agent 要么留成裸数字,要么写 `fixed` 加本位币代码(ADR-0144 不允许)。
- 风险与回滚:只改技能文字、一个评测用例和一行 token 棘轮上限(field-types.md 3208→3349,按实测钉住),不动运行时。回滚 = revert。
- 先看:`field-types.md`「A roll-up of the home field」那段和示例。
- 两分钟验证:对照 `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` 的 case (d) 与 `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` 的 `refuseUnadmittedSummaryCurrency`,看三条规则是否逐条对得上。
- 需要你做的:受管面 Tier H(diff 含 `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,低风险技能臂不适用)。达档(CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER)复审:首轮 6898808993 PASS(F1 should-fix),delta 6898898914 在本 head PASS,F1 已关。请批准并合并,或批准后由席位落地。
- 席位意见:可以合。

## 席位核对

**Verdict: ACCEPT, held for the maintainer** · head `7c9814a64061be3cf7d34f7e728519593569f3b3` · card #33714 · report 6898745814 · at-tier contract review 6898808993 (PASS on `78cfc281`, F1 should-fix) + delta 6898898914 (PASS on this head, `F1: closed`, `N1: closed`, `N2: closed`) · read 2026-11-15T18:11Z.

- **Shape:** draft → `main`, `Fixes #33714`. `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md`, case 20 appended to `skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json`, one ratchet row, changeset `'@objectstack/skills': patch`. **GOVERNED**, Tier H. `Clause-②: no`; `Metadata-protocol: none`.

- **Gates:** on this head, none failed. Green so far: Build Core, Test UI, Live E2E UI, Dogfood Regression Gate, Check Changeset, PR-body guards, every Type Check job, and the Lint families that carry the skill gates and the ratchet (docs & code guards, repo & tooling gates, CI/release/engine, ESLint, tooling self-tests, query-options erasure). Two Test Core shards and two Lint families (slot lookup & corpus, PM dispatch-gates) are still running at this read. Dev at `78cfc281`: 63 derived, 63 exit 0, `--ran` reconciles. At this head the dev re-ran the ratchet and the skill-docs, skill-refs, skill-examples and skill-links gates, all exit 0.
- **Accepted deviations:** authoring by a subagent pinned to `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` inside a lower-tier thread (declared in the claim and body). Main merged in. The ratchet raise was paid down first by two same-file cuts, and each cut rule keeps its home. Nits N3 (no `relationshipField` in the snippet) and N4 (a quoted refusal of `defaultCurrency: 'USD'` would trip the case, as in cases 18 and 19) are left as they are.
